clips.title: The story
paras: Gazlowe needs the Telescopic Lens to finish the observatory telescope above Ratchet’s harbor. Southsea pirates took it from a ship, and the lens remains in their camp south of town.

Ratchet is known chiefly for ruthless commerce, but its overseer and chief engineer, Gazlowe, has greater mechanical ambitions. His observatory rises above the harbor to house a telescope for watching maritime traffic and the stars. The larger lens came safely overland from Durotar. The smaller, vital lens traveled by sea, where Southsea Freebooters prey on merchant lanes off the Barrens coast.

The Southsea Freebooters took anything of value when they raided the transport ship, including the delicate optics. The pirates may have left the lens among the clutter of their beachside camp south of Ratchet because they could not appreciate its craft or did not know how to pawn it. Gazlowe needs the unblemished glass brought back so his observation deck can come into focus.
